|sellprice = 2000 |quality = false }} The '''Monster Compendium''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be dropped by [[monsters]]. The chance for a monster to drop the book starts at 0.01% and increases by 0.015% for each monster killed until it is dropped. Then the chance stays at 0.05% permanently. It cannot drop until the player has killed more than 10 monsters. It can also be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|20000}} starting in Year 3 (≈9% chance to appear). The first reading grants the player a power that gives all monsters a 3% chance to drop double loot. This effect stacks with that of the [[Burglar's Ring]]. Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s Menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 100 [[Combat]] [[Skills|XP]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Abigail,Penny,Krobus |like=Elliott,Sebastian |neutral=Pierre,Caroline,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Jodi,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Linus,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Kent,Sam,Leo |dislike=Alex }} ==Bundles== Monster Compendium is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Monster Compendium is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used as a black [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== Monster Compendium is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Trading== Two Monster Compendiums can be traded to the [[Bookseller]] for either 1 [[Slime Egg-Press]] or 1 [[Slime Incubator]], provided the player has already obtained the power from this book. ==Trivia== *It is possible to obtain two [[Prismatic Jelly]] using this book's power, although this has no effect on the Wizard's Special Order. ==References== See GameLocation::monsterDrop in the game code.
